author: PokeRunecrafter
body:
My 246 GSA build 

https://imgur.com/a/K8BBNAy

I have 105k ward with these items, great enough for fully clearing towers, any raid/event bosses including guild raids and horde mode boss dungeons. Only thing I can’t reliably do is anguished endless dungeons.

You need to unlock hydrus for summon ancient dragon but you will be playing as Auriga for the far better results. You will only use benefactor. You will need a celestial axe and upgrade it to 20 for the great amount of ward % that comes with it. You will need to farm battlegrounds (t9 dungeons in the snow area, drops from baldyr) for ornate baldyr helmet and boots as they give great ward %. 

Tower grinding should be: 100% always open with ward of ortanite as this makes dmg received drop to 15%, 85% goes directly to ward which is why you need to stack ward% on gear. You should be using ancient dragon and jhin or buggane and jhin and on your next turn summon more bugganes. 

Priority list for you:

1. Buy the spell ward of ortanite

2. Farm the amnity that grants 5 turns of ward at start of battle (perma use this)

3. Farm high percent Ornate baldyr helmet and boots and upgrade to master/godforge. 

4. Farm ornate arisen mammon shield (bis ward% bonus)

4. Farm tower shards to unlock Auriga then hydrus, (hydrus only for summon ancient dragon at like lvl 230 or 235).

5. Farm out your celestial axe and upgrade to 20 and adorn with titan limbs (most combinations are fine, my augments are heal hp/mana when dmg taken, less summon turns and auto heal ward every turn).

6. Chase the endgame best in slot items and level to 245 for summon great hydra.

You will need to unlock deity t10 class to unlock deific channel at some point as this will speed your raids up greatly. 


Your endgame raid rotation will look something like this: 
Open with ortanite, summon 5x ancient dragons or great hydras pending on raid boss resistances, activate divine bastion II (this makes 100% of dmg go to ward and not hp, 3 turn spell but much better than 85% ortanite), spam ward of ortanite to get a bunch of ward turns, then deific channel to give yourself +T.All 3, finally  rhada pact 2 to transfer this T.All buff to your summons and sit back and watch them do all the work. 


Endless dungeons are not for GSA, every other content is. My max is currently 180 I think.

I’m currently 246 and just unlocked greater hydra and they slap. When I buff my dragons in raids with t.all 3 and they inflict drakeblight, they usually deal 80-120k per dragon per hit. I can comfortably clear any raid boss or event boss. 

GSA is slower than other classes earlier on but scales the best with higher ascension levels (your summons get +1% stats every ascension level).

author: petr1petr
body:
you should start with +view equips - thats what you should wear for world.

next - check on various GS builds: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JDNee0miAjx\_pGWp6MxrEq\_e7NnmJsbS11x60brE4sw/edit?gid=0#gid=0](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JDNee0miAjx_pGWp6MxrEq_e7NnmJsbS11x60brE4sw/edit?gid=0#gid=0)

towers are very important for progressing - I would aim for axe first - ward regen is great to have. you should get some "survival gears" - a lot of ward helps - try to get arisen surtr armor - ask in your kingdom, if someone has fey jorm scrolls. use shield and 1h weapon

GSA is much easier than GSH - for GSH you may really need some special equips, while GSA can go naked. GSH needs to know how pacts work, how to heal your summons and what is affecting dmg - GSA just needs to know, where is the button to summon something. ofc, the more you know, the faster you can progress, so it is good idea to check on how things work.

second omega riftlock helps a lot - try to get it.

I wonder why is ancient troll charm not translated - I would say, that it is older than omega riftlock.. do you switch between languages?
